collections.title: Everyday Essentials
collections.description: Useful system capabilities for planning, communication, and daily information.

collections.title: On the Go
collections.description: Location, routes, weather, and communication capabilities for tasks away from your desk.

packages.name: Reminders
packages.description: List, create, and complete reminders through the system Reminders store.

interface.longDescription: Use Apple's Reminders store through Goose to inspect bounded reminder ranges, create reminders with explicit details, and mark reminders complete.
defaultPrompts: What reminders do I have today?
Remind me tomorrow at 9:00 AM to send the report.

packages.name: Calendar
packages.description: Create events and inspect bounded Calendar ranges.

interface.shortDescription: Create events and inspect your calendar.
interface.longDescription: Use Apple's Calendar data through Goose to create events, query explicit time ranges, and find availability without inventing attendees or invitations.
defaultPrompts: Find a free hour on Friday afternoon.
Add a calendar event for the project review tomorrow at 2:00 PM.

packages.name: Contacts
packages.description: Search and conservatively save system contacts.

interface.longDescription: Search Apple's Contacts store and save or update a contact only when the user explicitly asks and provides usable contact information.
defaultPrompts: Save this phone number to Taylor's contact.

packages.name: Weather
packages.description: Read current, hourly, and daily Apple Weather conditions.

interface.longDescription: Read current, hourly, and daily Apple Weather conditions for named places or, with permission, the user's current location.
defaultPrompts: Will it rain in Singapore this evening?
Show me the forecast for the next five days.

packages.name: Maps & Location
packages.description: Use one-shot location, search nearby places, plan routes, and hand approved navigation to Apple Maps.

interface.shortDescription: Find places, plan routes, and open navigation.
interface.longDescription: Use one-shot location when needed, search structured place results, plan routes, and hand approved navigation off to Apple Maps.
defaultPrompts: Plan a walking route to the nearest MRT station.
Open navigation to the place we just selected.

packages.name: Message & Mail
packages.description: Prepare editable Messages and Mail drafts in Apple's system composers.

interface.shortDescription: Prepare editable message and email drafts.
interface.longDescription: Prepare Messages and Mail content in Apple's system composers. Goose opens an editable composer after approval and does not claim a message was sent without a structured result.
defaultPrompts: Draft a message to Sam saying I'm running ten minutes late.
Prepare an email to the team with this week's update.

packages.name: Health
packages.description: Read objective activity, sleep, and workout summaries from HealthKit without storing raw samples.

interface.longDescription: Read bounded HealthKit summaries for activity, steps, sleep, and workouts without storing raw samples or turning objective values into diagnosis or health advice.
defaultPrompts: How many steps did I take this week?
